ring-header.reason: The question asks how many bytes the header contains. A bare '4' answers it when the verified page quotation establishes that the unit is bytes.
ring-header.original_check: Required '4 bytes' or 'four bytes' in the answer text.
ring-header.revised_check: Also accept an answer consisting only of '4' or 'four' with optional terminal punctuation. The verified PDF quotation is still required.
ring-header.applies_to: Both models, all revisions. --score recomputes exact PDF passes from the unchanged model output.
